digest.component_or_area: autodeploy MCP target with in-flight drain gate
propositions: Add immutable blue-green MCP target to autodeploy.sh that atomically swaps nginx upstream without stopping in-flight containers
Memory pre-check on /proc/meminfo MemAvailable < MCP_MEM_MIN_MB (default 1024) aborts deploy with AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT and prevents container start

Start new container via docker run -d on free A/B port (8092 or 8093), health-check /health within MCP_HEALTH_TIMEOUT (default 120s), flip nginx config atomically, then gracefully retire old container with docker stop --time 1260 (SIGTERM self-drain)
Port exhaustion: when both MCP_PORT_A and MCP_PORT_B are bound by managed containers, emit AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP and do not start a third container
Change detection on MCP_PATHS triggers only mcp target; shared src/rebar changes trigger both mcp and review-bot independently
Graceful retire issues docker stop (SIGTERM) to old container, never docker rm -f/SIGKILL, allowing in-flight certified ops to drain before container exit
